coverageGaps: Numeric returns are raw IEEE-754 bits, never forced through a Boolean ABI. Normal floating arguments and unresolved generic entries are refused.
TryGetFloat output is a selected native byref pointer, sampled before/after; only a normal return supplies a lookup result. A false return is not a successful zero-value lookup.
HealPackData is a value type: its normal instance entry receives an unboxed this pointer. That address is a temporary value carrier, not a managed-object identity.
Expression identity without a nested keyed lookup does not reveal the expression key or its literal. Healing return is a calculated amount, not an observed final HP write.
